speed_method: Tracked ground displacement divided by source-video time; numeric geometry, not a trained speed regressor.

models.role: Vehicle detection; ByteTrack associates detections over time.
models.license: AGPL-3.0; upstream also offers commercial licensing.

models.role: Eight projected vehicle cuboid corners. This is the actual geometry checkpoint used in the saved CCTV runs.
models.interface: Eight XY points, no per-point confidence in this pinned checkpoint. Ground face ordering must be checked; the stored runs use corners 0-3.

calibration_artifacts: JSON road mappings and diagnostics, camera-specific; no calibration.pt.
training: No detector/geometry neural weights were fine-tuned in this project. Do not substitute the old local vehicle_keypoints.pt.
